old,_=solver.revalidate_cached_payload(data,reference,quality_context=context,**verification)
save('reference_revalidation.json',old)
save('conditions.json',dict(started_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),time_limit=600,
    hint_payload=None,fixed_schedule=None,options=options,
    reference_status=old['status'],reference_errors=old['checks']['errors'],
    hashes={name:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in
            ['src/creche_planning/solver.py','src/creche_planning/pattern_mip.py','data/gwendo.json','config/solveur_config.json']}))
started=time.monotonic()

def progress(percent,message):
    print(f'{time.monotonic()-started:.3f}|{percent}|{message}',flush=True)

def checkpoint(payload,bundle):
    save('checkpoint.json',payload)
    print(f"CHECKPOINT {time.monotonic()-started:.3f} score={solver.planning_quality_score(payload)}",flush=True)

result,bundle=solver.make_ortools_slot_payload(data,time_limit=600,hint_payload=None,fixed_schedule=None,
    debug_log_path=OUT/'cp_sat.log',progress_callback=progress,candidate_callback=checkpoint,**options)
save('result.json',result)
summary=dict(elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-started,3),status=result['status'],
             solver_message=result.get('solver_message'),statistics=result.get('cp_sat_statistics'),
             reference_status=old['status'],reference_errors=old['checks']['errors'])
if result.get('schedule'):
    checks=solver.verify_solution(bundle,result['schedule'],
        primary_groups_by_educator=result.get('checks',{}).get('primary_groups_by_educator',{}),**verification)
    summary['independent_errors']=checks['errors']
    summary['score']=solver.planning_quality_score(result)
    if result['status']=='ok' and not checks['errors']:
        save('selected.json',result)
        summary['selected']='new_candidate'
    else:
        summary['selected']=None
else:
    summary['selected']=None
save('summary.json',summary)
print('SUMMARY '+json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
